description: Work card with composed opening, metadata and actions. The same molecule is used in the column and in the KanbanBoard drag preview.

howToUse: Use it for one work item on a board: title, owner, due date, tags.
Open the detail in `onOpen`, usually in a Drawer. Put quick actions in `actions`.
Inside KanbanBoard the drag handle comes from the board; alone, the card only shows the item.
alternatives: A full board with columns: KanbanBoard.
Content to read, with image: ContentCard.

keyboard.action: Moves to the title, which opens the card, and to the actions.
Opens the card or runs the action in focus.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Surface tone. `inverted` = dark (ink) surface with a radial brand
gradient and inverted text tokens scoped to the card, the base of the
billing/usage heroes (plan-summary, usage-hero).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
